event.title: Cars & Coffee
event.description: Start your month the fun way at Cars & Coffee, held the first Saturday of every month at 9:00 a.m. Join us for coffee and donuts—and most importantly, a parking lot full of cool cars. Bring your ride to show off, or come stroll and check out what others drive. Enjoy free museum admission until 11:00 a.m., and stick around afterward for our Tread Talk.

event.title: Art + Car Culture from a Rat Fink Artist- October Tread Talk
event.description: Get ready to dive into the colorful and creative world of Rat Fink and Kustom Kulture with artist Dan-O! Inspired by legendary artist Ed “Big Daddy” Roth and the Kustom Kulture scene, Dan-O has been creating art since elementary school. During this special Tread Talk, he’ll share his journey as an artist, what inspired him to become a Rat Fink artist, and the history behind the Kustom Kulture movement. Dan-O’s artwork has been featured in magazines, books and coloring books, and he currently has 36 pieces in the Rat Fink Museum. He’ll also bring along some of his artwork and share stories about his experiences as an artist in the car show world. Whether you’re a longtime Rat Fink fan, an admirer of Kustom Kulture, or simply interested in the connection between cars and art, this is a Tread Talk you won’t want to miss! Come early for our monthly Cars & Coffee and stay for this great presentation! Free admission to the museum until 11 a.m.

event.title: Tailgate & Tractor Show
event.description: Join us for an afternoon celebrating the people and machines that help feed America! The Tailgate & Tractor Show at Midwest Dream Car Collection will be an afternoon filled with tractors, great food, live music, family activities, and FREE museum admission all day! Whether you’re a lifelong farmer, a tractor enthusiast, or just looking for a fun family outing, you’ll enjoy: 🚜 Antique & Modern Tractor Display 🍔 Cookout 🎵 Live Music 🎃 Fun Fall Activities 🌽 Cornhole Tournament 🚗 FREE Admission to the Midwest Dream Car Collection 🚜 Bring Your Tractor! We’re inviting owners of both antique and modern tractors to display their machines. Whether it’s a beautifully restored classic or the newest model in the field, we’d love to have you join the show. Come celebrate agriculture, community, and the equipment that has shaped generations. Bring the whole family—we’ll see you at the museum!

event.title: British Invasion: Members-Only Reveal
event.description: The British are coming… and our members get the first look! Join us for an exclusive Members-Only Reveal of British Invasion, our newest exhibit celebrating the charm, style and spirit of classic British automobiles. Be among the first to explore the new exhibit featuring a collection of iconic British cars, including a special showcase of MG sports cars. Enjoy an up-close look at the vehicles, discover their stories, and get a sneak peek before British Invasion opens to the public. Drinks and appetizers will be served. Enjoy live music as you stroll the exhibit. This special evening is our way of saying thank you to the members who help make Midwest Dream Car Collection possible! Membership has its perks — including being first through the doors! Membership must be current to enter. We will be selling MDCC memberships at the door.

event.title: British Invasion- MG Exhibit
event.description: A little British style is rolling into Midwest Dream Car Collection! British Invasion celebrates the charm, character and unmistakable style of classic British automobiles, with a special showcase of MG sports cars. From sleek roadsters to iconic designs, this exhibit highlights the cars that helped make British motoring a favorite around the world. Come explore the history, craftsmanship and personality behind these distinctive vehicles and experience a little piece of Britain on four wheels! On display at MDCC Oct. 24th through end of March 2027.

event.title: Open Hood Sunday
event.description: Experience the museum in a whole new way during Open Hood Sunday! Get an up-close look under the hoods of some of our most iconic vehicles as engines are opened and stories come to life. This interactive experience offers a deeper dive into the design, engineering, and history behind the cars—perfect for enthusiasts of all ages. See the details you don’t normally get to see on the showroom floor. Open Hood Sunday takes place the last Sunday of every month, giving you a rare up-close look under the hoods of some of our most iconic vehicles. Join us in March, June, September, and December for Start Up Sunday, when you’ll not only see what’s under the hood—you’ll hear the roar of the engines as they come to life. It’s an unforgettable experience for car lovers of all ages!

event.title: Haunted Horsepower Halloween
event.description: Halloween is rolling into Midwest Dream Car Collection! Join us Saturday, October 31 for a FREE, family-friendly Halloween celebration! Bring the kids in their favorite costumes and come trick or treat at the museum! We’ll have plenty of candy, treats and Halloween fun waiting for our little ghosts, goblins, superheroes and car enthusiasts. 🍬 Lots of candy & treats 🎃 Halloween fun for the whole family 🚗 More than 65 incredible cars to explore 👻 Costumes encouraged! 💰 FREE EVENT from 12-4 PM!
